iWantTo: view a SKU's stock across all its locations, including its tracking code
soThat: I can see the complete inventory picture for one SKU and identify units by their combined tracking code

independence.rationale: S2 shows stock across all SKUs and locations on the home screen. This story adds a detail view for a single SKU (navigation and filtering by SKU), displays the tracking code (new data dimension), and handles the optional par level field with explicit messaging. The detail-page navigation and SKU-scoped presentation are distinct from the home-screen aggregated view.
